Date : 14th August, 2024.
Heard the learned advocates for applicants, learned APP and the learned counsel for assisting the prosecution.
2 The learned advocates for applicants submit that the applicants have been exonerated from the liability by the appellate authority.
The said order has been challenged by the informant by way of writ petition, which is pending before this Court.
Till the pendency of the writ petition, interim protection be giving the the applicants.
3 The learned APP and the learned counsel for assisting the prosecution strongly objected for granting the interim protection.
4 In my view, the offences are registered against the applicants on the basis of audit report.
The said audit report was challenged by the applicants before the appellate authority.
The appellate authority has 3 974 aba.657.24 others.odt set aside the audit report.
The said order has been challenged by the informant by way of writ petition, which is pending before the learned Single Judge of this Court.

5 Considering these facts, till the next date, in the event of arrest of applicants in connection with Crime No.245 of 2024, registered with Rahuri Police Station, District Ahmednagar, for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 465 and 477-A read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3 of the M.P.I.D. Act, they be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/-
each with one surety in the like amount by each of them.
The applicants shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
6 Stand over to 28th August, 2024.
